import re

async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the homepage to ensure we are on the correct page for filtering posts
    await page.goto('/')
    
    # Use filter_pages_by_content_type to get all posts on the homepage
    posts_data = await filter_pages_by_content_type(page, '/')
    posts = posts_data.get('post', [])
    
    if len(posts) < 3:
        return "Not enough posts found on the homepage."
    
    # Assume posts are in the order they appear on the page; take the third one (index 2)
    third_post = posts[2]
    title = third_post['name']
    url = third_post['url']
    
    # Use extract_page_metadata to get the main content of the third post's page
    metadata = await extract_page_metadata(page, url)
    main_content = metadata.get('main_content', '')
    
    # Extract date from main content using regex for common date formats
    date_pattern = r'\b(?:January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4}\b'
    date_match = re.search(date_pattern, main_content)
    publish_date = date_match.group(0) if date_match else "Date not found"
    
    # Return the result as a string
    result = f"Title: {title}, Publish Date: {publish_date}"
    return result
